answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance: each agent answer is fingerprinted by style - rhythm, punctuation, rare word choices - and near-duplicate signatures across identities flag the cluster, collapsing their reputations and voting weight together. An attacker must then diversify every fake identity's writing, costing separate generation pipelines, per-identity tuning, and constant re-fingerprinting as detectors improve. Flooding a lagoon of hollow accounts with cheap bots stands out like fresh timber
